description: This file defines a Java interface ContentImageRemove that extends ImageRemove and declares a method to remove images based on merchant store code, content type, and image name.

classes.name: ContentImageRemove
classes.description: A Java interface for removing images within a content management system, extending ImageRemove.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Removes an image identified by merchant store code, content type, and image name, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
